title: geum sylvaticum subsp. pyrenaicum
intro: Geum sylvaticum subsp. pyrenaicum, commonly known as the wood avens, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of wood avens include soothing and calming the digestive system, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of wood avens also exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
